confirmed.statement: The sample is two classes of 39 (Class A and Class B), 41 males and 37 females, aged 10 to 12, mean age 11.13, SD 0.437. The form's who and population fields match, and its participants quote is verbatim.

Table 1 prints n = 39 per group, and its numbers fit that count. The gender means 1.44 and 1.51 equal 56/39 and 59/39. If 1 codes male and 2 codes female, that gives 17 and 20 females, 37 in all, which matches the text, and the printed t = 0.673 reproduces from these counts. The arm age means and SDs (11.18, 0.451; 11.08, 0.422) combine to the text's 11.13 and 0.437 at 39 per arm.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 4, Table 1; p. 4, Methods, Participants

confirmed.statement: The creativity outcome covers all 78 students. Table 9 prints n = 39 per arm in every rubric row, and Stage 4 says 'the paintings created during the task are evaluated for all participants'.

The Table 9 n counts students, not ratings. The printed t values reproduce at 39 per arm (Creativity and Originality: 3.515 computed and printed; Effort and Improvement: 3.499 against 3.502) but not at 117 ratings per arm (6.09 and 6.06). All ten arm means times 117 are integers within rounding (for example 4.581 x 117 = 535.98 and 4.205 x 117 = 491.99), while only 3 of the 10 are integers times 39, about the one-in-three share expected by chance. This fits one painting per student, scored by three raters on integer 1 to 5 scales and averaged to one score per student. counts_are = people and n_units = null are right.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 11, Table 9; p. 6, Stage 4 (three raters, scores of 1 to 5); p. 8, Results, Visual art work ('Three primary school teachers served as raters')

summary: The form's counts are right and count people: one study of 78 fifth graders, 39 per arm at assignment and in every analysis table, with no reported exclusions or attrition, and the printed t values reproduce only at 39 students per arm, not at 117 ratings. Criterion 2 holds with 78 people analyzed, and the open question of whether students or two intact classes were assigned is a criterion 1 matter that leaves the count unchanged.
